tools.name: famly_list_sites
tools.description: Site IDs and titles accessible to this API token. Sites are currently not paginated by Famly. Uses the Famly Public API; results depend on token permissions.

tools.name: famly_list_groups
tools.description: Room/group IDs, titles, institution IDs and staffing ratios for the requested site sets. Uses the Famly Public API; results depend on token permissions.

tools.name: famly_list_employees
tools.description: Staff directory and employment dates. No home address, birth date, gender, telephone or photographs. Continue using next, including after an empty page. Uses the Famly Public API; results depend on token permissions.

tools.name: famly_list_invoices
tools.description: Invoice IDs, numbers, totals and dates, excluding line descriptions, child records and PDF links. One page per call. Uses the Famly Public API; results depend on token permissions.

tools.name: famly_get_invoices
tools.description: Invoice summaries for known invoice IDs: numbers, totals, dates and bill payer IDs. Uses the Famly Public API; results depend on token permissions.

tools.name: famly_list_payments
tools.description: Payment amounts, dates, method, currency and transaction status. Excludes notes, bank details, child records and payment metadata. One page per call. Uses the Famly Public API; results depend on token permissions.

tools.name: famly_list_purchases
tools.description: Ad-hoc purchase IDs, status, totals and invoice IDs, excluding child records and booking details. With a date range request one site at a time. One page per call. Uses the Famly Public API; results depend on token permissions.

tools.name: famly_list_account_codes
tools.description: Accounting code IDs, titles and references for the requested sites. Uses the Famly Public API; results depend on token permissions.

tools.name: famly_list_bill_payers
tools.description: Billing identities, names, balances and billing references. Excludes bank accounts, social security numbers, contact details, notes and child records. One page per call. Uses the Famly Public API; results depend on token permissions.

tools.name: famly_list_work_tags
tools.description: Staff work-tag IDs, names, colour and payroll codes for a site set. Uses the Famly Public API; results depend on token permissions.

tools.name: famly_get_staff_hours_totals
tools.description: Staff contracted, attended, scheduled and break minutes plus differences. Excludes leave categories, health information and notes. Date range maximum 365 days; one page per call. Uses the Famly Public API; results depend on token permissions.

tools.name: famly_list_employee_checkins
tools.description: Staff check-in/out timestamps and work-tag IDs. Excludes manager notes and all child check-ins. Famly may return the full date range when nextToken is omitted: narrow the range. If next is returned, pass it as nextToken. Uses the Famly Public API; results depend on token permissions.
